prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished mobile website section mockup for Indonesian savings application SAKINA, portrait composition. This is a design preview to replace the four small line icons in a "how it works" section with sizeable friendly 2D illustrations featuring people.
Style: clean flat 2D editorial illustration, smooth vector-like shapes, warm friendly human characters, muted sage green, forest green, cream, golden yellow, coral and pale blue. Absolutely no 3D objects, no photorealism, no clay render. Consistent drawing style across all four illustrations.
Layout: pale sage background, comfortable 24px padding, dark forest green heading and smaller gray explanatory text, below it four white rounded cards in a two-column two-row grid. Each card has a large dedicated illustration at the top, step number subtly in the top-right, then bold heading and short legible description. The illustrations must fill the top half of each card naturally without tiny square icon tiles. Keep characters and objects entirely within their card, no cropping. Premium lightweight website look, good spacing and mobile readability.
Text above cards, exactly:
"SEMUDAH SATU, DUA, TIGA"
"Impian terwujud, selangkah demi selangkah."
"Empat langkah sederhana untuk mulai menabung."
Card 01: illustration of a young Indonesian woman wearing a sage hijab, checking a phone showing a small goat and grocery product choice, with a small friendly goat beside her. Heading "Pilih Produk". Description "Temukan kambing atau paket sembako yang Anda inginkan."
Card 02: illustration of a young Indonesian man in a green shirt dropping a gold coin into a rounded transparent savings jar, smiling, with a small seedling nearby. Heading "Mulai Menabung". Description "Pilih tenor dan lihat nominal cicilan yang sesuai."
Card 03: illustration of a young Indonesian woman in a cream hijab using a phone, next to a calendar and a payment receipt with a checkmark. Heading "Bayar Setiap Bulan". Description "Unggah bukti pembayaran untuk diverifikasi admin."
Card 04: illustration of an Indonesian family receiving a grocery basket from a friendly farm worker, with a small goat beside them, a warm completed-goal moment. Heading "Terima Produk". Description "Setelah lunas, ajukan jadwal serah terima produk."
This is only the section mockup, no device frame, no navbar, no website footer, no watermark. The people are the main illustrative focus; use tasteful minimal scenery. Spell all Indonesian copy accurately.
processing: Illustration regions extracted from the approved preview and resized for the responsive cards.
